title: Extend the typed locale catalog to conversation
description: Extend the internal locale seam from the shell into the primary conversation column while keeping en-US as the only production-selected locale. Rename shell-locale.ts to locale.ts now that the module owns more than the shell, and keep one dependency-free, type-complete catalog record keyed by the existing closed Locale union. Preserve the existing nested shell catalog and add one conversation section with the Gateship-owned text rendered by ConversationColumn, ChatLog, ChatCostSummary and OperatorAnswer: transcript accessible label, empty-state guidance, operator/orchestrator role labels, title and description, cumulative-cost sentence with correct singular/plural, waiting-decision prompt, response label/placeholder/button, composer accessible label/placeholder/button. Both en-US and pt-BR must satisfy the same explicit interface at compile time; components read typed fields or typed message functions directly, with no generic string-key lookup, fallback registry, React context or package. Pass the conversation subcatalog explicitly from HomeSurface to the components that render it. Make USD formatting accept the explicit Locale and use Intl.NumberFormat for that locale; existing run-cost callers keep en-US behavior until the runs surface is migrated. Never translate chat message text, provider identifiers, run summaries, command status returned by the server, or any operator-authored/durable content. Do not migrate the current-run inspector in this slice, so pt-BR remains test-only and cannot expose a partially translated home page. Extend the existing static-render tests in place to render the conversation column explicitly in both locales and assert its accessible labels, primary copy, decision form and composer without adding a wording-regex gate or snapshot file. Rebuild the UI and keep the existing embedded-bundle proof. Make HANDOFF.md resilient after this merge: remove volatile claims that a specific implementation branch is active or that a hard-coded installed version is current, tell future agents to inspect origin/main and /api/snapshot for those facts, record GSHIP-668 as shipped, and describe the stable resulting phase as shell plus conversation internally localized with remaining route catalogs still hidden before any selector. Preserve historical evidence and the rule that roadmap prose is not execution authority. Out of scope: visible locale selection, persistence, browser inference, the run inspector, /runs, /work, /settings, onboarding, client/server status and validation messages, notifications, orchestrator prompts, operator content, endpoints, SQLite, dependencies, or lifecycle behavior.
